title: Masterstipend for mangfoldskunnskap
requirements_text: Du kan søke på denne ordningen hvis du er masterstudent og er tatt opp på et masterprogram. Du må legge ved anbefalingsbrev fra veilederen din. Studenter med minoritetsbakgrunn eller minoritetserfaringer i vid forstand oppfordres til å søke. For å kunne søke må du ha bakgrunn fra Norge eller studere ved en utdanningsinstitusjon i Norge. I 2026 gir Kulturdirektoratet masterstipend til studenter som har startet eller skal starte arbeidet med masteroppgaven vårsemesteret 2026, høstsemesteret 2026 eller vårsemesteret 2027.
requirements_text_en: You can apply for this scheme if you are a master's student and have been admitted to a master's programme. You must attach a recommendation letter from your supervisor. Students with minority background or minority experiences in a broad sense are encouraged to apply. To be eligible to apply, you must have background from Norway or study at an educational institution in Norway. In 2026, the Norwegian Directorate for Culture gives master stipends to students who have started or will start working on the master's thesis in the spring semester 2026, autumn semester 2026 or spring semester 2027.
project_requirements: Du kan søke om masterstipend til masterprosjekter som handler om mangfold i kunst  og kultursektoren. Prosjektene skal bidra til å realisere utlysningens formål. I denne ordningen gir vi normalt ikke tilskudd til aktiviteter som er gjennomført før søknadsfristen. Prosjekter som faller utenfor ordningens formål eller rammene for Kulturdirektoratets koordinatoroppdrag, kan ikke få tilskudd. I søknaden må du også bekrefte at du vil delta på et felles arbeidsseminar for stipendmottakere. Merk at seminaret vil finne sted i Kulturdirektoratets lokaler i Oslo. Dersom du har lang reisevei, vil Kulturdirektoratet dekke reisekostnadene.
how_to_apply: Søknaden må leveres gjennom Kulturdirektoratets søknadsportal. Søknaden skal inneholde utfylt søknadsskjema inkludert prosjektbeskrivelse prosjektsammendrag som kan offentliggjøres anbefaling fra veileder Vi ønsker ikke vedlegg ut over dette. Merk at prosjektsammendrag ikke skal inneholde personopplysninger og sensitiv informasjon. Søknaden må være fullstendig når du sender den inn. Du kan ikke ettersende informasjon. Prosjektbeskrivelsen kan være på inntil 7000 tegn med mellomrom (ekskl. sammendrag og litteratur- og kildeliste). Disposisjonen skal følge Kulturdirektoratets mal. Prosjektbeskrivelsen skal inneholde tittelen på prosjektet sammendrag forskningsidé og problemstillinger bakgrunn metode og teori relevans hva stipendet skal brukes til framdriftsplan eventuelt litteratur- og kildeliste Prosjektsammendraget skal være på inntil 500 tegn med mellomrom. Sammendraget kan bli offentliggjort. Anbefalingen fra veileder skal være på maksimalt én side. Andre opplysninger i søknaden Våren 2026 er det mulig å søke masterstipend både gjennom denne ordningen (altså Kulturdirektoratets masterstipend for mangfoldskunnskap) og gjennom Kulturrådets tilskuddsordning «Kunst- og kulturforskning – masterstipend». Du må angi i søknadsskjemaet hvis du også søker masterstipend fra Kulturrådet. Hvis du får innvilget stipend fra Kulturrådet, vil du ikke bli prioritert i Kulturdirektoratets ordning.

selection_criteria: Søknadene vurderes enkeltvis og i sammenheng med de andre søknadene som er med i samme søknadsrunde. I den helhetlige vurderingen av søknadene tar vi blant annet hensyn til mangfold i erfaringer og perspektiv og til geografisk og institusjonell spredning. Vi tar utgangspunkt i prosjektbeskrivelsen og anbefalingsbrevet fra veileder når vi vurderer søknaden. Vi legger vekt på prosjektets relevans – hvordan det bidrar til å oppfylle formålet for ordningen kvaliteten i prosjektbeskrivelsen originaliteten i forskningsideen prosjektets gjennomførbarhet
program_dates: I 2026 gir Kulturdirektoratet masterstipend til studenter som har startet eller skal starte arbeidet med masteroppgaven vårsemesteret 2026, høstsemesteret 2026 eller vårsemesteret 2027.
project_requirements_en: You can apply for a master’s scholarship for master’s projects that deal with diversity in the arts and culture sector. The projects must contribute to realizing the purpose of the call. Under this scheme, we normally do not grant support for activities that have been completed before the application deadline. Projects that fall outside the purpose of the scheme or the framework of the Norwegian Directorate for Culture’s coordinator assignment cannot receive support. In the application, you must also confirm that you will participate in a joint working seminar for scholarship recipients. Note that the seminar will take place in the Norwegian Directorate for Culture’s premises in Oslo. If you have a long travel distance, the Norwegian Directorate for Culture will cover travel costs.
how_to_apply_en: The application must be submitted through the Norwegian Directorate for Culture’s application portal. The application must include a completed application form including project description project summary that can be made public recommendation from supervisor We do not want attachments beyond this. Note that the project summary must not contain personal data or sensitive information. The application must be complete when you submit it. You cannot send additional information later. The project description may be up to 7000 characters including spaces (excluding summary and literature and source list). The outline must follow the Norwegian Directorate for Culture’s template. The project description must include the title of the project summary research idea and research questions background method and theory relevance what the scholarship will be used for progress plan and possibly literature and source list The project summary must be up to 500 characters including spaces. The summary may be made public. The recommendation from the supervisor must be a maximum of one page. Other information in the application In spring 2026 it is possible to apply for a master’s scholarship both through this scheme (that is, the Norwegian Directorate for Culture’s master’s scholarship for diversity knowledge) and through the Arts Council Norway’s grant scheme “Art and culture research – master’s scholarship”. You must indicate in the application form if you are also applying for a master’s scholarship from Arts Council Norway. If you are granted a scholarship from Arts Council Norway, you will not be prioritized in the Norwegian Directorate for Culture’s scheme.
selection_criteria_en: Applications are assessed individually and in relation to the other applications included in the same application round. In the overall assessment of the applications, we take into account, among other things, diversity in experiences and perspectives and geographical and institutional spread. We base our assessment of the application on the project description and the recommendation letter from the supervisor. We emphasize the project’s relevance – how it contributes to fulfilling the purpose of the scheme the quality of the project description the originality of the research idea the project’s feasibility
program_dates_en: In 2026, the Norwegian Directorate for Culture awards master’s scholarships to students who have started or will start work on the master’s thesis in the spring semester of 2026, the autumn semester of 2026, or the spring semester of 2027.

requirements_text: Ordningen stiller ikke særlige krav til hvem som kan søke, men tiltaket du søker om, skal involvere profesjonelle kunstnere og/eller profesjonelle kunst- og kulturformidlere. requirements_text_en: The scheme does not set any special requirements for who can apply, but the measure you are applying for must involve professional artists and/or professional arts and culture communicators. project_requirements: Du kan søke om prosjekttilskudd til tidsavgrensede prosjekter. Du kan få tilskudd til å utvikle nye prosjekter, etablere ny virksomhet og videreutvikle eksisterende virksomheter som: Konsertarrangører og musikkfestivaler Musikere, musikkgrupper og institusjoner Støttefunksjoner som kan tilby kompetanse, ressurser og nettverk

selection_criteria: Søknaden blir vurdert av musikkutvalget for komposisjon, produksjon og andre musikktiltak . Utvalget leser og diskuterer alle søknadene og bruker sin samlede kompetanse til å bestemme hvilke prosjekter som skal få tilskudd. Søknadene vurderes enkeltvis og i sammenheng med de andre søknadene i samme søknadsrunde. Kulturrådet ønsker å fremme et mangfold av aktører, uttrykk og estetiske praksiser, aktivitet i hele landet og at barn og ungdom møter kunst og kultur. Utvalget legger vekt på at ordningen skal komme både etablerte og nye aktører til gode bidra til at tiltak når målgrupper med ulik økonomisk, sosial og kulturell bakgrunn ha et spesielt blikk for nye strømninger og musikkfeltets ytterpunkter ta hensyn til kjønnsbalanse Disse målsettingene blir tatt med i totalvurderingen når utvalget fordeler budsjettet de har til rådighet. Når utvalget vurderer hver enkelt søknad, legger de vekt på det kunstneriske/faglige innholdet kvalitetene i prosjektet i hvilken grad prosjektet er relevant for ordningens formål om prosjektet har et realistisk budsjett og er gjennomførbart Utvalget ser også etter om medvirkende kunstnere og fagpersoner får betalt i tråd med gjeldende eller anbefalte satser klima- og naturhensyn i gjennomføringen om vilkår for tidligere tilskudd er fulgt opp, slik som krav til rapportering, regnskap og gjennomføring Søker du om tilskudd til å gi ut faglitteratur , legger utvalget spesielt vekt på den faglige kvaliteten i utgivelsen, relevansen den har på sitt fagfelt, og betydningen den kan få i offentligheten. Søker du om tilskudd til prosjekter for barn og ungdom , legger utvalget spesielt vekt på i hvilken grad de unge inngår i samarbeidet med de profesjonelle kunstnerne i hvilken grad de unge får muligheten til å uttrykke seg og prosessere samtiden gjennom kunstneriske uttrykk hvor relevant den kunstneriske ideen eller konseptet er for de unges livsverden hvor godt tiltaket er tilpasset det særegne ved de ulike aldersgruppene I hvilken grad tiltaket har vilje og evne til å bevege seg ut av tradisjonelle former for formidling hvordan tiltaket eventuelt legger til rette for dialog med og innflytelse fra de unge om tiltaket bidrar til utvikling, kritisk refleksjon og samtaler
program_dates: Du kan søke tilskudd fra høsten 2026 og ut 2027.
project_requirements_en: You can apply for project grants for time-limited projects. You can apply for operating grants for organizations with year-round professional operations if you have previously received project grants or operating grants. You can apply for grants to carry out measures that cannot receive grants from other music schemes in the Arts Council Norway. From the application deadline 15 September 2026, music actors with Indigenous and national minority backgrounds can apply for special funding priorities from the Arts Council Norway. The initiative shall contribute to new initiatives, collaborations and meeting places, and strengthen activity, recruitment and visibility for musical expressions from Indigenous peoples and national minorities – Sámi, Jews, Roma, Kvens/Norwegian Finns, Forest Finns and Romani/Taters. You can receive grants to develop new projects, establish new operations and further develop existing operations such as: Concert organizers and music festivals Musicians, music groups and institutions Support functions that can offer expertise, resources and networks
how_to_apply_en: The application is submitted on the ordinary application form.
selection_criteria_en: The application is assessed by the music committee for composition, production and other music measures . The committee reads and discusses all applications and uses its collective expertise to determine which projects shall receive grants. The applications are assessed individually and in relation to the other applications in the same application round. The Arts Council Norway wants to promote a diversity of actors, expressions and aesthetic practices, activity throughout the country and that children and young people encounter art and culture. The committee emphasizes that the scheme shall benefit both established and new actors contribute to measures reaching target groups with different economic, social and cultural backgrounds have a special focus on new trends and the outer edges of the music field take gender balance into account These objectives are included in the overall assessment when the committee allocates the budget at its disposal. When the committee assesses each individual application, it emphasizes the artistic/professional content the qualities in the project the extent to which the project is relevant to the purpose of the scheme whether the project has a realistic budget and is feasible The committee also looks at whether participating artists and professionals are paid in accordance with current or recommended rates climate and nature considerations in implementation whether conditions for previous grants have been followed up, such as requirements for reporting, accounts and implementation If you apply for grants to publish non-fiction literature , the committee places particular emphasis on the professional quality of the publication, its relevance in its field, and the significance it may have in the public sphere. project_requirements:
Prosjekttilskudd til spesifikke konserter og turneer. Vi gir tilskudd til enkeltturneer eller til flere konserter eller turneer i løpet av et år. Søker dere prosjekttilskudd, kan dere søke om prosjekttilskudd ved alle ordningens tre søknadsfrister alle konsert- og turnérelaterte utgifter inngå i søknaden, også utgifter til nødvendige prøver eller nødvendig preproduksjon og administrasjon som har med konsertene å gjøre prosjektperioden være maks ett år

Virksomhetstilskudd

Med virksomhetstilskudd mener vi tilskudd som inngår i den samlede årlige finansieringen av en virksomhet eller en fast aktivitet. Det vil si at dere må søke for hele kalenderår og beskrive samlet konsert- og turnévirksomhet, utvikling og drift gjennom hele året i søknaden. For å søke om virksomhetstilskudd må dere være en virksomhet med organisasjonsnummer eller ha en fast aktivitet med eget navn og budsjett, som inngår i en større virksomhet gjennom minimum tre år ha hatt omfattende konsertvirksomhet gjennom hele året og/eller være et større ensemble eller band som har hatt helårig drift gjennom minimum tre år Dere kan søke tilskudd for inntil tre år, og vi oppfordrer til å søke flerårig tilskudd. Vær oppmerksomme på at dere bare kan søke ved søknadsfristen i september. Vær også oppmerksomme på at utvalget kan tildele en annen tilskuddstype enn den dere har søkt om.
how_to_apply: Søknaden må leveres gjennom Kulturrådets søknadsportal. De obligatoriske vedleggene er: 3–5 lydeksempler i mp3-format og/eller videoeksempler i mp4-format som i så stor grad som mulig gir et inntrykk av de medvirkende utøverne og av prosjektet og musikken som skal framføres. Vi godkjenner ikke lenker til nettsider med lydeksempler. spesifisert budsjett Valgfrie vedlegg: CV Alle CVer skal samles i ett dokument. Vi ønsker ikke flere vedlegg enn dette. All annen informasjon må dere legge inn i feltene i søknadsskjemaet. selection_criteria: Søknaden blir vurdert av musikkutvalget for konserter og turneer. Utvalget leser og diskuterer alle søknadene og bruker sin samlede kompetanse til å bestemme hvilke tiltak som skal få tilskudd. Søknadene vurderes individuelt og i sammenheng med de andre søknadene i samme søknadsrunde. Kulturrådet ønsker samlet å fremme et mangfold av aktører, uttrykk og estetiske praksiser, aktivitet i hele landet og at barn og ungdom møter kunst og kultur. Utvalget legger vekt på at ordningen skal komme både etablerte og nye aktører til gode bidra til at konserter og turneer når målgrupper med ulik økonomisk, sosial og kulturell bakgrunn bidra til konsertvirksomhet i hele landet og i utlandet, men med særlig vekt på konsertvirksomhet i Norge ta hensyn til kjønnsbalanse og geografisk fordeling i utøvermiljøer, repertoar og nedslagsfelt Når utvalget vurderer hver enkelt søknad, legger de overordnet vekt på det kunstneriske innholdet kvalitetene i tiltaket i hvilken grad tiltaket er relevant for ordningens formål om tiltaket framstår som realistisk og virker økonomisk og praktisk gjennomførbart Utvalget ser for eksempel etter tiltakets og utøvernes kunstneriske kvaliteter, egenart og utviklingspotensial om det er planlagt et rimelig aktivitetsomfang om tiltaket framstår som realistisk og virker økonomisk og praktisk gjennomførbart om ressursbruken er fornuftig med tanke på turnéplanlegging og merbruk av verk og produksjoner om det tas hensyn til klima- og naturbelastning i turnéplanleggingen om medvirkende kunstnere og fagpersoner får betalt i tråd med gjeldende eller anbefalte satser om vilkår for tidligere tilskudd er fulgt opp, slik som krav til rapportering, regnskap og gjennomføring I søknader om virksomhetstilskudd vurderer utvalget virksomhetens oppfyllelse av formål i vedtekter eller strategidokumenter, der dette finnes kunstneriske og kulturfaglige kvaliteter rolle og betydning i musikkfeltet tilgjengelighet, publikumsarbeid og lokale betydning økonomiske og organisatoriske soliditet og stabilitet honorarnivå til kunstneriske og faglige medvirkende bevissthet om og plan for reduksjon av klima- og naturbelastning behov for offentlig tilskudd oppfølging av vilkår for tidligere tilskudd Dersom aktiviteten er tilknyttet et fast sted, vurderer utvalget også virksomhetens lokale/regionale forankring og medfinansiering. Hvis dere mottar fast årlig statstilskudd, vurderer utvalget i tillegg om tiltaket ligger utenfor virksomhetens kjerneoppgaver, og hvordan virksomheten bidrar til gjennomføringen.
project_requirements_en:
Project grants for specific concerts and tours. We provide grants for individual tours or for several concerts or tours over the course of a year. If you are applying for project grants, you can apply for project grants at all three application deadlines of the scheme all concert- and tour-related expenses may be included in the application, including expenses for necessary rehearsals or necessary pre-production and administration related to the concerts the project period must be a maximum of one year

Operating grants

By operating grants we mean grants that are included in the overall annual financing of an activity or a regular activity. This means that you must apply for the entire calendar year and describe the overall concert and tour activity, development and operations throughout the year in the application. To apply for operating grants, you must be an activity with an organization number or have a regular activity with its own name and budget, which is part of a larger activity for a minimum of three years have had extensive concert activity throughout the year and/or be a larger ensemble or band that has had year-round operations for a minimum of three years You can apply for grants for up to three years, and we encourage you to apply for multi-year grants. Please note that you can only apply at the September application deadline. Please also note that the committee may award a different type of grant than the one you applied for.
how_to_apply_en: The application must be submitted through the Arts Council’s application portal. The mandatory attachments are: 3–5 audio examples in mp3 format and/or video examples in mp4 format that, to the greatest extent possible, give an impression of the participating performers and of the project and the music to be performed. We do not accept links to websites with audio examples. specified budget Optional attachments: CV All CVs must be collected in one document. We do not want more attachments than this. All other information must be entered in the fields in the application form. In the application form, the following must among other things be included project description list of participants concert list budget and financing plan overview of the project period
selection_criteria_en: The application is assessed by the music committee for concerts and tours. The committee reads and discusses all applications and uses its collective expertise to determine which measures should receive grants. The applications are assessed individually and in relation to the other applications in the same application round. The Arts Council wishes overall to promote a diversity of actors, expressions and aesthetic practices, activity throughout the country and that children and young people encounter art and culture. The committee emphasizes that the scheme should benefit both established and new actors contribute to concerts and tours reaching target groups with different economic, social and cultural backgrounds contribute to concert activity throughout the country and abroad, but with particular emphasis on concert activity in Norway take into account gender balance and geographical distribution in performer environments, repertoire and reach When the committee assesses each individual application, it places overall emphasis on the artistic content the qualities of the measure the extent to which the measure is relevant to the purpose of the scheme whether the measure appears realistic and seems economically and practically feasible The committee looks, for example, at the artistic qualities and distinctiveness of the measure and the performers, and its development potential whether a reasonable scope of activity is planned whether the measure appears realistic and seems economically and practically feasible whether the use of resources is reasonable with regard to tour planning and repeated use of works and productions whether climate and nature impact is taken into account in tour planning whether participating artists and professionals are paid in accordance with current or recommended rates whether conditions for previous grants have been followed up, such as requirements for reporting, accounts and implementation In applications for operating grants, the committee assesses the activity’s fulfillment of the purpose in statutes or strategy documents, where these exist artistic and cultural professional qualities role and significance in the music field accessibility, audience work and local significance economic and organizational solidity and stability fee levels for artistic and professional contributors awareness of and plan for reduction of climate and nature impact need for public grants follow-up of conditions for previous grants If the activity is associated with a fixed venue, the committee also assesses the activity’s local/regional anchoring and co-financing. If you receive a fixed annual state grant, the committee additionally assesses whether the measure lies outside the activity’s core tasks, and how the activity contributes to implementation.

description: A call for participants to take part in an artist-led workshop for women of colour at LUX. The workshops are part of Beverley Bennett’s ongoing research project toward a new artist film, and will include cooking, drawing, reading, listening to music, and an open sharing event.
description_en: A call for participants to take part in an artist-led workshop for women of colour at LUX. The workshops are part of Beverley Bennett’s ongoing research project toward a new artist film, and will include cooking, drawing, reading, listening to music, and an open sharing event.
title: Workshops for Women: Simon Says/Dadda
requirements_text: women of colour
requirements_text_en: women of colour
project_requirements: Beverley Bennett is looking for 8 participants to take part in a project entitled Simon Says/Dadda as part of an ongoing research project working towards the production of a new artist film of the same name. She is looking for women of colour to share stories with her about their family relationships with men and how living in a patriarchal society effects their day to day life. As part of the workshops participants will cook, draw, read and listen to music together over a 4 week period within a relaxed friendly environment at LUX in Waterlow Park, Highgate. The workshops will culminate in an open sharing event at LUX.
how_to_apply: If you are interested in getting involved please email [email protected] and with the subject heading ‘SS/D London’, participants will receive confirmation on 5th August.
program_dates: Workshops will commence on the 19th August – 17th September 2019.

description: Urbs, Virus & Bits is an online pilot course that explores the city through environmental humanities, digital practices, art, and speculative urban invention. It combines theoretical and practical sessions with invited contributors, and participants are encouraged to develop a small project or exploration during the course. The programme culminates in a presentation of the results.

El coste total de la matrícula es de 80€, para inscritos de forma individual o en equipos.

Para estudiantes, jubilados y desempleados que se inscriban de forma individual el coste total de la matrícula es de 50€, siendo necesario presentar la documentación que acredite esta circunstancia para poder aplicar el descuento.

title: Urbs, Virus & Bits Imagining a School of Environmental Humanities and the City
requirements_text:
El curso está abierto a personas y grupos interdisciplinares de todos los ámbitos, y dirigido especialmente a arquitectos, diseñadores, ingenieros, artistas, antropólogos, geógrafos, científicos sociales e investigadores en ciencias, artes y humanidades.

Os animamos a inscribiros como equipos, de entre dos y seis personas.

Para estudiantes, jubilados y desempleados que se inscriban de forma individual el coste total de la matrícula es de 50€, siendo necesario presentar la documentación que acredite esta circunstancia para poder aplicar el descuento.

For students, retirees, and unemployed people who enroll individually, the total tuition fee is €50, and it is necessary to present documentation proving this circumstance in order to apply the discount.

description: This call invites participatory, proximity-based artistic projects to be developed within and around Matadero Madrid. It supports collaborative proposals that connect the center with the social and cultural fabric of the districts of Arganzuela and Usera, and selected projects will take place between October 2025 and December 2026.
discipline: artes plásticas, visuales, textuales, artes escénicas y performativas, diseño, arte digital y transmedia, arquitectura, urbanismo
description_en: This call invites participatory, proximity-based artistic projects to be developed within and around Matadero Madrid. It supports collaborative proposals that connect the center with the social and cultural fabric of the districts of Arganzuela and Usera, and selected projects will take place between October 2025 and December 2026.
discipline_en: artes plásticas, visuales, textuales, artes escénicas y performativas, diseño, arte digital y transmedia, arquitectura, urbanismo
title: INTERMEDIAE DISTRIBUIDO
requirements_text:
proyectos artísticos de mediación, participación y proximidad que interpela especialmente el contexto artístico y asociativo de los distritos de Arganzuela y Usera

proyectos participativos de artistas, agentes y colectivos culturales y/o sociales que quieran desarrollar proyectos en colaboración y sintonía con los dos Distritos de Madrid (Arganzuela y Usera) que abrazan y circunscriben Matadero Madrid.
requirements_text_en:
artistic projects of mediation, participation and proximity that especially engage with the artistic and associative context of the districts of Arganzuela and Usera

participatory projects by artists, agents and cultural and/or social collectives who wish to develop projects in collaboration and in harmony with the two districts of Madrid (Arganzuela and Usera) that embrace and circumscribe Matadero Madrid.
project_requirements:
La presente convocatoria, de conformidad con los principios de transparencia, igualdad y concurrencia y en consonancia con las líneas de programación de Matadero Madrid e Intermediae Matadero, tiene como objeto final apoyar proyectos participativos de artistas, agentes y colectivos culturales y/o sociales que quieran desarrollar proyectos en colaboración y sintonía con los dos Distritos de Madrid (Arganzuela y Usera) que abrazan y circunscriben Matadero Madrid.

La propuesta promueve la interculturalidad y el fortalecimiento del tejido social -con un entendimiento amplio de las diferentes manifestaciones culturales-, fomenta el trabajo cooperativo y el aprendizaje y aboga por superar la barrera entre creador y espectador.

Los proyectos que se presenten a la convocatoria deberán enmarcarse en alguna de las siguientes ideas o líneas temáticas:

- Metodologías experimentales

- Hacer ciudad

- Permacultura y sostenibilidad
selection_criteria:
transparencia, igualdad y concurrencia

la creación de sinergias y redes entre artistas y agentes locales con estructuras de diversa índole (instituciones culturales, espacios o proyectos de iniciativa privada o independiente) en sintonía con Matadero Madrid

conocer, desarrollar y fortalecer aquellas propuestas artísticas locales que incorporan perspectivas cruzadas como el género, la ecología, los cuidados, el antirracismo o el fortalecimiento de las comunidades, tanto emergentes como situadas
program_dates: entre octubre de 2025 y diciembre de 2026
project_requirements_en:
This call, in accordance with the principles of transparency, equality and competition and in line with the programming lines of Matadero Madrid and Intermediae Matadero, has the final purpose of supporting participatory projects by artists, agents and cultural and/or social collectives who wish to develop projects in collaboration and in tune with the two Districts of Madrid (Arganzuela and Usera) that embrace and circumscribe Matadero Madrid.

The proposal promotes interculturality and the strengthening of the social fabric -with a broad understanding of the different cultural manifestations-, fosters cooperative work and learning and advocates overcoming the barrier between creator and spectator.

The projects submitted to the call must fit into any of the following ideas or thematic lines:

• Experimental methodologies
• Making city
• Permaculture and sustainability
selection_criteria_en:
transparency, equality and competition

the creation of synergies and networks between artists and local agents with structures of diverse kinds (cultural institutions, spaces or projects of private or independent initiative) in tune with Matadero Madrid

to know, develop and strengthen those local artistic proposals that incorporate cross-cutting perspectives such as gender, ecology, care, anti-racism or the strengthening of communities, both emerging and situated
program_dates_en: between October 2025 and December 2026

requirements_text_en:
2 dance artists each, both of whom are at the beginning of their professional activity in the field of contemporary dance and have their work and life center in Berlin.

Both residents must be registered in Berlin and have their work and life center in Berlin.

Students are not eligible for the residency program.

In that case, each of the two must submit all application documents and, under “Explanation of collaborative working method,” explain in what way the two artists share the residency and, above all, where the points of overlap lie (e.g. development of feedback structures and other possibilities for mutual support). Individual applications by artists with a solo research project are not possible.

description: Alpaca is a festival on Algorithmic Patterns in the Creative Arts, with live performances, workshops and conference talks. title: 2025 workshop: Juggling siteswap patterns with Mees Jager
requirements_text:
We invite proposals for performances, workshops and talks.
We welcome performance proposals of different types; if you’re unsure whether your performance will fit then please do get in touch with the organisers to discuss.
We are open to proposals for any kind of workshop, for example hands-on workshops exploring an approach, idea or technology around pattern-making.
We’d love to hear your ideas – if you’re unsure whether it will fit then just get in touch to discuss!
This year, we encourage conference talk submissions to address the theme of making languages and notations for making patterns .
Unexpected and radical interpretations of it are welcomed.
Submissions may explore pattern languages and notations in traditional technologies such as in textile/fibre arts, music, juggling or choreography that might not involve computers at all.

title: Wettbewerb 2026 – Gestaltung eines Impuls- und Resonanzortes im Kirchenraum
requirements_text:
Zur Teilnahme eingeladen sind Gestalter*innen, Designer*innen, Künstler*innen freier und angewandter Bereiche, Architekt*innen aus dem In- und Ausland.
Die Teilnehmenden müssen die eingereichten Arbeiten selbst entworfen und ausgeführt haben. Arbeiten, die üblicherweise nur unter Mitwirkung anderer gestaltet werden können, müssen maßgeblich von den Teilnehmenden beeinflusst worden sein. Eine Teamarbeit bei Entwurf und Ausführung ist zulässig, muss jedoch auf der Teilnahmeerklärung vermerkt werden.
title_en: Competition 2026 – Designing a space of impulse and resonance in the church interior
requirements_text_en:
Invited to take part are designers, artists from the fields of fine and applied arts, and architects from Germany and abroad.
The participants must have designed and executed the submitted works themselves. Works that usually can only be created with the involvement of others must have been significantly influenced by the participants. Teamwork in the design and execution is permitted, but must be noted on the participation declaration.
project_requirements:
Es handelt sich um einen offenen und anonymen Wettbewerb. Zu erbringen ist ein Entwurf gemäß der oben beschriebenen Gestaltungsaufgabe für die Pfarrkirche St. Dionysius in Nordwalde. Es wird eine hohe künstlerische Qualität sowie liturgische Sensibilität erwartet.
Maßstab, Materialität und Platzierung müssen auf die Architektur der Kirche abgestimmt sein. Techniken und Materialien sind frei wählbar (Malerei, Skulptur, Relief, Installation, Lichtkunst …).
Die Arbeit soll für eine dauerhafte Installation im Kirchenraum konzipiert sein.
Zu berücksichtigen ist daher, 
– dass die später realisierte Arbeit und Raumgestaltung die vor Ort üblichen gottesdienstlichen Vollzüge und die pastorale Arbeit mitbedenkt  
– und dass das zur Gestaltung ausgewiesene Areal prominent in der Sichtachse der beiden Hauptzugänge zum Kirchraum liegt.
Die eingesandten Wettbewerbsbeiträge dürfen keine Nachbildung fremder Arbeiten sein. Sie dürfen noch nicht bei anderen Wettbewerben eingereicht oder in einschlägigen Publikationen veröffentlicht worden sein.
how_to_apply:
Gefordert werden:
• ein maßstäblicher, aussagekräftiger Entwurf oder ein Modell (maximal 70 cm x 40 cm x 40 cm),
• eine Erläuterung (maximal 4.000 Zeichen) in deutscher oder englischer Sprache,
• Angaben zum Material und zu Details der Gestaltung,
• ein Kostenvoranschlag für die Realisierung (maximal 40.000 Euro).
Pro Teilnehmer*in ist eine Wettbewerbsarbeit zugelassen.

This is an open and anonymous competition. A design is to be submitted in accordance with the design task described above for the parish church of St. Dionysius in Nordwalde. A high artistic quality as well as liturgical sensitivity are expected.
Scale, materiality and placement must be matched to the architecture of the church. Techniques and materials are freely selectable (painting, sculpture, relief, installation, light art …).
The work is to be conceived for a permanent installation in the church space.
It must therefore be taken into account,
• that the work and spatial design to be realized later take into consideration the liturgical practices customary on site and the pastoral work
• and that the area designated for the design is prominently located in the line of sight of the two main entrances to the church space.
The competition entries submitted may not be copies of other works. They may not yet have been submitted to other competitions or published in relevant publications.
how_to_apply_en:
Required are:
• a scale, meaningful design or a model (maximum 70 cm x 40 cm x 40 cm),
• an explanation (maximum 4,000 characters) in German or English,
• information on the material and details of the design,
• a cost estimate for the realization (maximum 40,000 euros).
One competition entry per participant is permitted.

requirements_text:
Bénéficiaires Associations Communes Départements Entreprises privées Entreprises publiques locales EPCI à fiscalité propre Établissements publics / Services de l'État Particuliers Régions
L'appel à projets « Culture et Santé » s'adresse à tous les  acteurs de  santé de la  région Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur relevant du champ de compétence de l'Agence régionale de  santé.
Les projets présentés en réponse au présent appel à projets sont co -construits : ils sont le  résultat d’une collaboration étroite entre une structure de santé et une structure artistique et culturelle.
La Direction Régionale des Affaires Culturelles  ne peut apporter son soutien financier aux établissements publics sous tutelle directe du ministère de la Culture.
Les candidatures doivent être déposées par un établissement/service de santé parmi les suivants :
✓ Les établissements sanitaires de la région Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes (publics, ESPIC ou privés).
✓ Les organismes gestionnaires et les établissements et services médico-sociaux d'accueil ou d'accompagnement des personnes en situation de handicap et/ou de perte d’autonomie, avec une activité médicalisée, relevant du champ de compétences de l’ Agence régionale de santé en Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes (publics ou privés).
✓ Les établissements et services ou structures associatives intervenant dans le champ de la prévention et relevant du champ de compétences de l’ ARS.
✓ Les groupements d’établissements sanitaires et médico-sociaux, les groupements hospitaliers de territoire, avec la possibilité d’un portage administratif par un établissement pour le compte des autres.
✓ Les filières de soins.
Le dépôt d’un projet par une autre structure qu’un établissement/service de santé, est autorisé  de manière dérogatoire dans les cas suivants :
✓ Projet fédérateur à l’échelle d’un territoire rassemblant plusieurs établissements de santé/médico-sociaux autour d’une action pensée et coordonnée par le partenaire culturel.
✓ Premier projet développé dans un établissement de santé ou médico-social, de taille modeste et ne disposant pas de ressources internes suffisantes pour porter sa candidature dans de bonnes conditions et initier sa démarche culturelle.
La candidature peut alors être portée de manière exceptionnelle par le partenaire culturel qui est soit une structure culturelle labellisée ou repérée par les institutions partenaires, soit une collectivité locale (communauté de communes ou d’agglomération) dès lors qu’elle est signataire d’une CTEAC.
requirements_text_en:
Beneficiaries Associations Communes Departments Private companies Local public companies EPCI with own taxation Public establishments / State services Individuals Regions
The call for projects "Culture and Health" is addressed to all health actors in the Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur region falling within the area of competence of the Regional Health Agency.
The projects submitted in response to this call for projects are co-constructed: they are the result of close collaboration between a health structure and an artistic and cultural structure.
The Regional Directorate for Cultural Affairs cannot provide financial support to public establishments under the direct supervision of the Ministry of Culture.
Applications must be submitted by a health establishment/service from among the following:
✓ The healthcare establishments of the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region (public, ESPIC or private).
✓ Managing bodies and medico-social establishments and services for the reception or support of persons with disabilities and/or loss of autonomy, with a medicalized activity, falling within the scope of competence of the Regional Health Agency in Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes (public or private).
✓ Establishments and services or associative structures working in the field of prevention and falling within the scope of competence of the ARS.
✓ Groupings of healthcare and medico-social establishments, territorial hospital groupings, with the possibility of administrative management by one establishment on behalf of the others.
✓ Care networks.
Submission of a project by a structure other than a health establishment/service is authorized on an exceptional basis in the following cases:
✓ Federating project on the scale of a territory bringing together several health/medico-social establishments around an action designed and coordinated by the cultural partner.
✓ First project developed in a health or medico-social establishment, of modest size and not having sufficient internal resources to submit its application in good conditions and initiate its cultural approach.
The application may then exceptionally be carried by the cultural partner, who is either a cultural structure labeled or identified by the partner institutions, or a local authority (community of communes or urban community) provided that it is a signatory of a CTEAC.

project_requirements:
Les projets devront se dérouler sur une période comprise entre le 1er juin 2026 et le 30 juin 2027.
La Direction Régionale des Affaires Culturelles , l’A gence régionale de santé  et la Région Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur déclinent Culture et Santé  2025 sous forme de résidences d’artistes de création et de transmission  favorisant les démarches artistiques et culturelles participatives menées par des artistes.
Ce format d’intervention permet de présenter des propositions artistiques auprès de publics avec des résidences  d’au moins six semaines (consécutives ou non)  au sein de structures (Hôpital, EHPAD, maison de santé, centres de santé, etc.). La démarche comprend des temps de création et des temps de transmission auprès des publics.
L’ensemble des domaines artistiques sont concernés :  spectacle vivant (théâtre, musique, danse, cirque, art de la rue, etc.) arts plastiques, visuels, graphique, cinéma, livre et lecture, musées, pratiques numériques, etc.
Les projets devront être réalisés sur l’année civile 2026.
Seront aidés des projets artistiques et culturels co-construits entre trois partenaires : a minima un établissement de santé, un équipement culturel et un ou des artistes professionnels qualifiés.
Dans le souci d'aider un nombre plus importants d'établissements, les projets permettant une coopération entre plusieurs établissements de santé seront appréciés.
Les actions devront permettre à la fois :
 ✓ l’accès aux œuvres, 
 ✓ la pratique artistique, 
 ✓ le partage autour de savoir-faire, 
 ✓ la transmission de connaissances culturelles.
Du fait des publics touchés, et parce qu’il faut du temps pour favoriser la rencontre, les projets devront prévoir un minimum de 25h d’intervention artistique auprès des personnes participantes (hors diffusion, préparation et réunion).
Ces projets peuvent être pluridisciplinaires. Ils peuvent proposer des actions dans tous les domaines artistiques, le livre et la lecture, le patrimoine, les sciences sociales, l’architecture, la culture scientifique.
Ne pourront être soutenus :
 ✘ Les projets d’animation et les actions éducatives.
 ✘ Les ateliers d’art thérapie.
 ✘ Les médiations artistiques à visée relationnelle comme le théâtre forum ou le clown relationnel.
 ✘ Les actions portées par des associations intervenant à l’hôpital, et dont l’objet-même est l’intervention artistique auprès des personnes hospitalisées.
 ✘ Les actions relevant d’objectifs uniquement communicationnels, de formation ou de prévention.
 ✘ Les projets uniquement de programmation de spectacles, de concerts, d’expositions.
 ✘ Les initiatives isolées pensées par un service pour un service.
 ✘ Les actions inscrites dans le fonctionnement de l’institution.
 ✘ Les projets visant uniquement la participation des personnels.
 ✘ Les procédures de la commande publique ou du 1% artistique.

project_requirements_en:
Projects must take place over a period between 1 June 2026 and 30 June 2027.
The Regional Directorate of Cultural Affairs, the Regional Health Agency and the Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur Region are rolling out Culture and Health 2025 in the form of artist residencies for creation and transmission, promoting participatory artistic and cultural approaches led by artists.
This format of intervention makes it possible to present artistic proposals to audiences through residencies of at least six weeks (consecutive or not) within structures (hospital, nursing home, health centre, etc.). The approach includes creation periods and transmission periods with audiences.
All artistic fields are concerned: live performance (theatre, music, dance, circus, street art, etc.) visual arts, graphic arts, cinema, books and reading, museums, digital practices, etc.
The projects must be carried out during the 2026 calendar year.
Artistic and cultural projects co-built between three partners will be supported: at minimum a health establishment, a cultural facility and one or more qualified professional artists.
In order to help a larger number of establishments, projects allowing cooperation between several health establishments will be appreciated.
The actions must allow both:
• access to works,
• artistic practice,
• sharing around know-how,
• transmission of cultural knowledge.
Because of the audiences reached, and because time is needed to foster the encounter, the projects must provide for a minimum of 25 hours of artistic intervention with the participating people (excluding dissemination, preparation and meetings).
These projects may be multidisciplinary. They may propose actions in all artistic fields, books and reading, heritage, social sciences, architecture, scientific culture.
The following cannot be supported:
• animation projects and educational actions.
• art therapy workshops.
• artistic mediation with a relational purpose such as forum theatre or relational clowning.
• actions led by associations working in hospitals, whose very purpose is artistic intervention with hospitalised people.
• actions relating solely to communication, training or prevention objectives.
• projects consisting solely of programming performances, concerts, exhibitions.
• isolated initiatives designed by one department for one department.
• actions included in the institution’s operations.
• projects aimed solely at staff participation.
• public procurement procedures or the 1% artistic scheme.

requirements_text:
Eligible for submission are short films up to 30 minutes running time (incl. credits) - exception: Central German Competition.
All films have to be produced after 31 December 2024.
FILMFEST DRESDEN is not a premiere festival, therefore a film premiere is not necessary.
For the National and International Competition, only short fiction and animation films (incl. hybrid forms such as AnimaDoc, experimental or documentary fiction) will be considered.
For the International Competition: all production countries except Germany, German co-productions are accepted
For the National Competition: production country Germany, German co-productions are accepted
For the Central German Competition , animation, short fiction, experimental and documentary films with a connection to the federal states of Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt and/or Thuringia (e.g. production location, content or biography of the filmmaker) are eligible.
Running time max. 40 minutes (including credits).
For the Special Programmes (e.g. Kids, Youth, Open Air) documentaries and experimental films can also be submitted.

project_requirements:
Please make sure that your submission includes English subtitles if the original language is not English. This also applies to German-language productions.
When submitting your entry, please upload both a video file with English subtitles burned into the video and a subtitle file (format: SRT, STL, or XML).
Works-in-progress are eligible for entry if submitted by the deadline. The cut you submit should at least be picture locked. Please label your submission "work-in-progress” for example in the opening credits or the synopsis and specify what is incomplete and still to be finished (final sound mixes, colour correction or completed visual effects).
Re-submissions are not accepted !
Please note that, if your film is selected, only films on 35mm or DCP will be accepted for festival screenings!
how_to_apply:
Films can be submitted via the online submission platform www.shortfilmdepot.com only.
Register: If you are not a user of SHORTFILMDEPOT, register and fill out the form for each film you would like to submit. Upload your film and test if it plays correctly!
Submit: Search for FILMFEST DRESDEN and submit your film.

title: Contemporary Talents Competition: Water – Wattwiller
requirements_text:
The competition is open to visual artists of all nationalities and ages (18 and over).
Applicants must demonstrate a professional artistic practice and/or hold a degree from an art school. To be eligible, applicants must show a recent and sustained track record over the past five years, through several exhibitions (solo and/or group), publications (monographs, catalogues), or participation in artist residencies
The competition is open to any natural person (of legal age) from any country in the world (hereinafter referred to as «the Applicant»), except for previous winners of the competition.
requirements_text_en:

project_requirements:
The work submitted must be on the theme of Water.
For installations and sculptures, artists may submit either an existing work or a project. If submitting a project, a production budget of no more than €50,000 must be included.
For other artistic forms, only an existing work may be submitted. No additional production budget can be allocated for paintings, drawings, photographs or videos.
The submitted artwork (whether it consists of a single piece or a body of work) must focus exclusively on the theme of water.
Each candidate may submit only one artwork or project per year.
The work submitted must be on the theme of Water.
Each applicant may submit only one work or one project per year.
A work entered into the competition may not be resubmitted in a subsequent year, or at any later date.

requirements_text:
Il concorso si rivolge a ricercatorə, dottorandə e/o post-dottorandə di scienze umane, sociali e naturali o di altre discipline e ad artistə delle arti visive, design, architettura, cinema, letteratura, danza, teatro, musica, ecc. che abbiano concluso il Master (non è ammessa la candidatura di persone in corso di formazione al momento della domanda) oppure che abbiano comprovata esperienza in ambito artistico.

requirements_text_en:
The competition is addressed to researchers, doctoral candidates and/or post-doctoral candidates in the humanities, social sciences and natural sciences or in other disciplines, and to artists in the visual arts, design, architecture, cinema, literature, dance, theatre, music, etc. who have completed the Master’s degree (applications from people who are in training at the time of the application are not admitted) or who have proven experience in the artistic field.
Swiss citizens or persons with permanent residence in Switzerland who take part regularly in artistic initiatives on the national territory or who are affiliated with higher education institutions in Switzerland may participate in the competition.
Age limit: the candidate’s date of birth must be equal to or later than 01.01.1988.
In the same academic year, an application for participation in the other residency programmes (Milano and Palermo Calling) of the Swiss Institute may not be submitted.

• Legame comprovato con Roma e l’Italia, il suo patrimonio culturale o le sue istituzioni artistiche e/o scientifiche

project_requirements:
We are looking for a strong artistic concept that combines AI and XR technologies in a novel, interactive cultural experience.
This year’s theme: ANTHROPOMORPHISM – Between Human and Machine
Where does technology become human, and where does the human become technical?
The theme invites you to explore these attributions, transitions and hybrid forms between human and machine using XR and AI.
Possible approaches include:
Human machines (ELIZA effect, chatbots, humanisation, etc.)
Technologised bodies (embodiment, the human as dataset, body tracking, etc.)
Human-machine relationships (AI companions, parasocial relationships, etc.)
Chimeras and hybrid s (composite beings, fusion of human and technology, etc.)
Projection and power (biases, mechanisms of concealment, exercise of power and influence, etc.)
These thematic fields are invitations, not fixed categories. Your project is welcome to sit between them or at their intersections.
Concepts that use the immersive potential of XR to help shape the public discourse on the promises and risks of AI technologies through an artistic contribution have particularly good chances.
how_to_apply:
Your application should include the following documents (font size 12):
A letter of motivation of max. one A4 page
The concept, 2–5 A4 pages, with at least one visualisation (e.g. sketch, model). The use of AI should be described as precisely as possible.
An outline of the required work packages and responsibilities
Short CV(s) of max. half an A4 page per person
For each team member, a link to website(s) or a portfolio of relevant previous work
Applications may be submitted in German or English..
Further information on the application
Applications are accepted by email only, to hi-iuno@htw-berlin.de .

requirements_text_en: Texts by authors from Bremen who have not yet published any stories in the series (authors who have already published only shorter texts in one of the three workshop booklets are, of course, still welcome to send us a suitable text).

requirements_text_en: Any artist aged 18 or over may enter, from anywhere in the world.
project_requirements: All works submitted must be original creations by the artist. They must demonstrate originality and technical skill. Work produced under instruction, such as in structured workshops, or work deemed to be derivative of or copied from another artist, will be ineligible for selection. Works must have been completed within two years prior to the exhibition and must not have been previously exhibited at Mall Galleries. Works should not exceed 2.4m along their longest dimension. Acceptable media: All types of pastel including soft pastel, hard pastel, oil pastel, ink pastel, water-based pastel, conté crayons or sticks, sanguine, and other dry mediums that are similar in their application including charcoal, chalk, and pencil. Mixed media and three-dimensional works are welcome where pastel or another dry media is the primary medium. However, all work that is submitted must have a full description of the media used and any process which has been employed in the finished work beyond drawing and painting, e.g. printing, photography. Please note that failure to do this may result in unnecessary rejection on the grounds that work deserves to be judged on a like for like basis and because any buyer should be made aware of what they are buying. Works must be framed with picture glass (except in special circumstances as below, or by prior arrangement with the Society). Both the Mall Galleries and the Pastel Society reserve the right to not hang work that is considered ‘not fit for purpose.’ Glazing in Perspex and other similar transparent acrylic materials may be accepted, but only on works arriving from abroad or large works in frames exceeding 100 cm on the longest side.

Submissions are ONLINE ONLY and open from 17 August to 20 November 2026 Submit Now
• Register or log in to our Open Exhibition Submission System (OESS) to submit between 12 noon on Monday 17 August and Friday 20 November 2026
Upload your image/s in JPEG or PNG format and under 5MB. One image per submission must be submitted, showing the complete work. An optional two additional images per work may be submitted, showing details. The judges will make their decision based on these images, so please ensure that photographs are accurate and show work at its best. Also required is the title, medium, size (cm), year of completion, and price per work, plus there is the option to add an artwork description.
• Log in to the OESS from 12 noon on Friday 4 December to see if your work has been selected
• If selected, deliver your work on Saturday 16 January 2027, 10am to 5pm, to Mall Galleries, 17 Carlton House Terrace, London SW1Y 5BD
Works should be delivered unwrapped with the relevant form and labels, which are downloadable upon notification of selection.

project_requirements:
We invite artists, filmmakers, and experimental creators to submit machinima and game-based moving-image works that challenge convention, test the possibilities of digital form, and reflect on the cultural, political, and aesthetic conditions of life in computational worlds.
We are especially interested in works that adopt a critical or exploratory approach to game engines, gameplay footage, mods, assets, and simulated environments.
CGI-only animations will not be considered.
Selected works will be presented as part of the tenth edition of the Milan Machinima Festival opening on March 14, 2027.
If selected, we ask that the machinima not be screened elsewhere — including on personal websites or video-sharing platforms — for the duration of the festival.

Pour concourir, le candidat doit être inscrit en thèse ou titulaire d’un doctorat au moment de la soumission du dossier.
requirements_text_en:
The "François Daulte" grant is intended for francophone or anglophone researchers in history and art history who are enrolled in a doctoral thesis or who hold a doctorate.
To apply, the candidate must be enrolled in a doctoral thesis or hold a doctorate at the time of submission of the application file.
project_requirements:
La bourse de recherche « François Daulte » soutiendra des recherches en histoire et en histoire de l’art dans la lignée des champs d’étude de François Daulte, tout particulièrement sur les thématiques suivantes :
 La vie et l’œuvre de Frédéric Bazille, d’Alfred Sisley et d’Auguste Renoir
 Les débuts de l’impressionnisme
 L’impressionnisme et les arts graphiques
 Exposer et collectionner l’impressionnisme
 L’histoire de la critique d’art durant la seconde moitié du XIX e siècle
 La vie culturelle et artistique à Montpellier durant la seconde moitié du XIX e siècle
La bourse devra donner lieu à une publication liée au projet de recherche, numérique ou papier, durant les deux années suivant l’allocation de la bourse.
how_to_apply:
Chaque candidat devra rédiger un dossier de candidature pour la bourse « François Daulte » avec :
 Une présentation en français ou anglais de quatre pages (hors bibliographies et images éventuelles) de son projet ainsi que le calendrier envisagé de travail et un budget prévisionnel
 Un CV, incluant la liste des publications, travaux, conférences, colloques, enseignements
 Une lettre d’intention
 Le rapport de thèse
 Une éventuelle lettre de recommandation d’une personnalité scientifique appuyant la candidature
Le règlement dûment complété, daté et signé , règlement à télécharger en pièce jointe.
L’ensemble des documents seront à envoyer au musée Fabre sous la forme d’un envoi numérique avec la mention bourse « F
Pour être enregistré, le dossier de candidature complet doit obligatoirement faire l’objet d’un double envoi avant samedi 30 novembre 2026, minuit, par voie électronique ET par voie postale.

requirements_text: The opportunity is open to artists and makers based in Wales , working individually or collaboratively and at any stage of their creative practice. project_requirements:
The residency will lead to a new commissioned work for the Aberlleiniog Sculpture Trail, 20–21 March 2027 .

Because the Trail takes place across woodland, waterways, historic sites and community spaces, proposals should be sensitive to their environment and appropriate to the site in which they are eventually presented.

project_requirements: The duration of the performance must be between 9 and 12 minutes. The choreographies should be based on a contemporary and original movement language. The choice of topic and music is up to the artist. The choreographies or work samples to be presented must be submitted as an online link (YouTube or Vimeo) (NO WeTransfer link). Only lightweight, easily transportable props are permitted for the stage design. Their setup and strike must not delay the performance schedule. All props must comply with fire safety class B1 (flame-retardant). Hanging objects is not possible. Materials such as sand, water, stones, flour, powder, beads, marbles, etc., that soil the stage or require extensive cleaning after the performance are not permitted. requirements_text:
We want to hear from UK-based music creators working in any genre or discipline.
Artists join In Motion at different stages of their careers.
There is no single type of creator we are looking for.
You might work between genres or disciplines.
You might be developing a new strand of your practice, building your own creative pathways, contributing to a scene or community, or exploring new ways for people to encounter your work.
We are particularly interested in creators who are :
curious, self-directed and willing to reflect critically on their practice
open to experimentation and taking creative risks
capable of taking initiative in their own development
actively creating opportunities, connections or contexts for their work
ready to engage fully with an 18-month process of exploration, reflection and growth.

project_requirements: The programme begins with a six-month Discovery Phase , creating dedicated space to reflect on your practice, explore ideas, identify your strengths and ambitions and develop the relationships and plans that will support what comes next. This is followed by a 12-month Activity Phase , when you put those plans into action and develop a new creative project with a public-facing outcome. That outcome could be an EP, installation, event, educational resource, community workshop, work-in-progress sharing or proof of concept — or something else entirely. The important thing is that it connects directly to your development as an artist.
how_to_apply: The application process takes place in two phases . The first pha se of the application asks for some information about you and your practice, your re s ponses to the application questions and links to two examples of your work. You can respond to the application questions in writing or by submitting an audio or video – or reach out to Grace Bailey at: Grace.Bailey@Soundandmusic.org for alternative application approaches . A longlist of up to 40 applicants will be invited to complete the second phase, followed by interviews with 18 shortlisted applicants. Before you apply we recommend reading the information about In Motion and our Application Guidance, which covers the application and selection process and what you’ll need to submit .

title: FeatureLab 2027
requirements_text:
FeatureLab is open to creative teams of director and producer (together with a scriptwriter, if on board) from all over the world, developing their 1st or 2nd feature film projects. The programme is focused on film projects - fiction, creative documentaries, experimental, animation and any possible kind of cinema form - at an advanced stage of development.
a. The project must be the director’s 1st or 2nd feature film*.
b. At least a first draft of the script in English must be presented when applying (or an analogue document, according to the type of project).
c. Shooting must not begin earlier than 1st December 2027.
d. Only one project application per year, per filmmaker, can be submitted.
e. A project that is refused one year, can be resubmitted another year if the project has gone through substantial changes. The same project cannot be submitted a third time, if rejected the second time around.
f. Directors who have participated in a previous edition of FeatureLab (formerly called Framework) cannot apply to FeatureLab 2027, but they are eligible and welcome to take part in other TFL programmes.
g. Applicants must confirm their full availability for all the residential and online workshops, as well as for the TFL Meeting Event.
h. The working language of all workshops, meetings and events is English ; thus, a good knowledge of English is essential in order to participate, and all written materials, all versions and drafts of the project, must be translated into English.
*Are considered long features all those films over 60 minutes including fiction feature films, experimental films, animations and documentaries. In case of co-direction and Tv-product the committee can discuss the eligibility of the project.

- Logline (2 lines maximum)
- Updated CV for each applicant (2 pages maximum, per CV)
- Concept presentation (7,500 characters, spaces included)
- Pilot step outline structured in bullet points: a) if the pilot is a half-hour format (under 44 minutes), the outline must be 25 points maximum and 7,500 characters (spaces included) b) if the pilot is a one-hour-format (between 45 and 60 minutes), the outline must be between 35 and 45 points maximum and 10,000 characters (spaces included)
- The first five pages of the pilot script
- Writer’s statement (1 page maximum), explaining the writer’s personal connection to the project, motivation, and unique perspective on the series
- Producer’s letter of interest (1 page maximum), outlining the producer’s interest in the project and perspective on its production and co-production potential
- European co-production strategy document (1 page maximum), outlining the project’s potential for European co-production and the applicants’ strategy for developing it ( ONLY FOR PROJECTS FROM OUTSIDE EUROPE )
- Audiovisual approach documents (mood board, etc.), if available
- A short video introduction (2 mins maximum), in which the applicants explain, in their opinion, the most important selling points of their project and why an audience should be interested in watching the series. The spoken language of the video must be English (other languages with or without English subtitles will not be accepted). The video should be uploaded on YouTube, Vimeo, or Google Drive. The video link - and password, if needed

title: Photo Contest – Open Call
requirements_text:
L’appel à candidatures est ouvert à tout photographe amateur ou professionnel âgé de plus de 18 ans à la date de clôture de l’appel à candidature, le 1 novembre 2026.
Les photographes dont les séries ont été imprimées et exposées en 2025 ne peuvent pas candidater à l’édition 2027.
Ne peuvent participer : les membres de « Annecy Lac Photo », leurs conjoints et leur famille, - les membres du jury leurs conjoints et leur famille.
requirements_text_en:
The call for applications is open to any amateur or professional photographer aged over 18 on the closing date of the call for applications, November 1, 2026.
Photographers whose series were printed and exhibited in 2025 may not apply for the 2027 edition.
May not participate: members of "Annecy Lac Photo", their spouses and their family, - the members of the jury, their spouses and their family.
project_requirements:
Pour cette 4ème édition, ALP’ vous invite à répondre à l’appel à candidatures jusqu’au 1er novembre 2026 minuit par une série de photographies, sur le thème :
« Eloge de la lenteur ».
Chaque candidat ne peut envoyer qu'un seul dossier de candidature et une seule série cohérente de 8 photographies sur le thème.
Les photographies comprises dans la série seront en JPEG format, without borders, signature, or watermark, with dimensions of 1920 pixels on the longest side.
En participant à cet appel à candidatures, les photographes lauréats s’engagent, à être présents au Festival lors de la cérémonie d’ouverture le vendredi 19 mars 2027 au soir au dimanche 21 mars 2027.
Les photographies capturées au moyen d'appareils photo, qu'ils soient de type argentique ou numérique, ou de smartphones, seront éligibles.
how_to_apply:
L'inscription se fera via : 
> Un formulaire en se connectant sur le site : annecylacphoto.com
Le candidat devra fournir les informations décrites ci-après dans le formulaire : 
•Nom Prénom, 
•Pseudo (facultatif) 
•Adresse postale
•Adresse mail
•Date de naissance
•Amateur ou professionel
•Titre de la série
•Site internet et/ou instagram
•Biographie (1000 caractères maximum, espaces compris), 
•Présentation de la série (1000 caractères maximum, espaces compris).
L’inscription sera validée par un email envoyé au candidat.
> L’envoi de 8 photographies composant la série au format Jpeg, 
Photos sans bordures ni signature ni ﬁligrane, de dimension 1920 pixels sur le plus grand côté, nommées 
comme suit : Nom_Prénom_n° d'ordre dans la série (01, 02, 03… 08).jpg
Les photos seront envoyées par wetransfer.com (ou équivalent) à l'adresse suivante : 
concours@annecylacphoto.com

project_requirements_en:
For this 4th edition, ALP’ invites you to respond to the call for applications until November 1, 2026 at midnight with a series of photographs, on the theme:
“Praise of slowness”.
Each candidate may send only one application file and only one coherent series of 8 photographs on the theme.
The photographs included in the series will be in JPEG format, without borders, signature, or watermark, with dimensions of 1920 pixels on the longest side.
By participating in this call for applications, the winning photographers commit to being present at the Festival during the opening ceremony on Friday, March 19, 2027 in the evening until Sunday, March 21, 2027.
Photographs captured using cameras, whether film or digital, or smartphones, will be eligible.
how_to_apply_en:
Registration will be via:
> A form by logging on to the website: annecylacphoto.com
The candidate must provide the information described below in the form:
• Name Surname,
• Username (optional)
• Postal address
• Email address
• Date of birth
• Amateur or professional
• Title of the series
• Website and/or Instagram
• Biography (1000 characters maximum, spaces included),
• Presentation of the series (1000 characters maximum, spaces included).
Registration will be validated by an email sent to the candidate.
> Sending of 8 photographs making up the series in Jpeg format,
Photos without borders or signature or watermark, with dimensions of 1920 pixels on the longest side, named as follows:
Name_Surname_serial number in the series (01, 02, 03… 08).jpg
The photos will be sent by wetransfer.com (or equivalent) to the following address:
concours@annecylacphoto.com
